d: Over the past two decades, Becky has hoarded her home and motel property, including furniture, clothes and appliances; featured experts are psychologist Dr. Robin Zasio and extreme clean-up expert Cory Chalmers.
A woman blames her hoarding on demons possessing her home. A man faces charges when the hoard in his historic San Francisco Victorian house catches fire and almost burns down the block.
Experts help ex-marine James who hoards gym equipment. He must tackle his obsession before authorities send him a cleaning bill for more than his home is worth.

st: Season 2 Follow Up: Augustine, Judi, Dennis & Nadine
d: The crew catch up on the progress of people featured in previous episodes, including Augustine, Judi, Dennis and Nadene, and Bob and Deborah.
Judy is an extreme germaphobe who spends her entire day engaged in sanitising rituals. However, she happens to live in a severe and extremely filthy hoard that's overrun with mice.

A widow hoarder requires assistance from her daughters. After glancing inside and seeing the state of mother Teri's house, clinical psychologist Dr Zasio immediately calls the Child Protection Services.
